description: ERIES publishes wind-tunnel velocity profiles and surface pressures for a scaled high-rise building. Twenty-seven atmospheric boundary-layer profiles represent terrain categories and transitions. The native description gives a geometric scale of 1:492 and a rectangular building model. Measurements characterise the effect of approach flow on building wind loads. Coverage: Temporal coverage is not stated in the reviewed source. Geographic extent follows the named site or scope; unstated extents and sampling intervals remain unknown. Access: public 4TU.ResearchData metadata links describe the release. Formats: CSV, XLSX, PDF, STEP, JPEG and PNG images, Matlab scripts and plain text. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. Cost and present file access are unverified. Caveats: Laboratory scaling and terrain categories do not establish loads for every full-size building. Simulation uses follow the source-defined purpose above. Related resources are retained in the same native collection with their distinct identities.
